mkosi.configuration:
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

[Output]
Format=oci
CompressOutput=no
SplitArtifacts=
ManifestFormat=json

[Content]
Bootable=no
# Keep package-generated dates and archive mtimes fixed independently of snapshots.
SourceDateEpoch=0
WithDocs=yes
WithRecommends=no
CleanPackageMetadata=no
# These files describe the assembly attempt rather than runtime inputs.
# Keep /var/lib package state and /etc/ld.so.cache for installed-content evidence.
RemoveFiles=/var/cache/*
            /var/log/*

[Build]
BuildSources=
Incremental=no
CacheKey=nvkr-vm-runtime
ExtraSearchPaths=/inputs/nvkr-tar-v1

# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

[Output]
Format=oci
CompressOutput=no
SplitArtifacts=
ManifestFormat=json

[Content]
Bootable=no
# Keep package-generated dates and archive mtimes fixed independently of snapshots.
SourceDateEpoch=0
WithDocs=yes
WithRecommends=no
CleanPackageMetadata=no
# These files describe the assembly attempt rather than runtime inputs.
# Keep /var/lib package state and /etc/ld.so.cache for installed-content evidence.
RemoveFiles=/var/cache/*
            /var/log/*

[Build]
BuildSources=
Incremental=no
CacheKey=nvkr-vm-runtime
ExtraSearchPaths=/inputs/nvkr-tar-v1
